44249c8a-e84f-5c20-a9cd-a55457e98511.content: Identify the core problem users face when interacting with or collaborating through technology within the first two sentences of the opening paragraph.

21371c6c-c74f-5791-8f9b-6d099306bfb5.content: Articulate the rationale for addressing this interaction problem immediately within the first two sentences of the opening paragraph.

f69ea80c-0d56-5fe8-9d24-8793eefa6643.content: Specify the user, context, and interaction to be explored in the primary HCI research question.

18ebdcbc-cf5a-5e6c-b2cd-b4cd07d7e59e.content: Summarize the sequence of steps with a single flow diagram when proposing an unfamiliar interaction procedure.

5ab99a77-8836-50cf-8377-fdd23a208bc4.content: Indicate transition conditions between steps of the unfamiliar interaction procedure in the flow diagram.

b9b7932b-85c1-5a14-80f7-0983dbf22380.content: Present the master’s research schedule as phased periods for exploration, design, prototyping, and user evaluation.

fc0a3a72-2da2-5843-be3a-a4ff2adf8fac.content: Link one reviewable deliverable to each phase of the master’s research.

2f7092a7-2625-5d27-bd76-a13ee5809cc2.content: Place the gap left by HCI-related research and the proposed design and empirical contributions in close proximity.

a1857f07-36cd-5a6c-946d-a308e712e9eb.content: In a free-form proposal, separate the user problem into its own subsection heading.

895b5ac9-1aa4-51d2-b89a-94e9fe5b869d.content: In a free-form proposal, separate the design intervention into its own subsection heading.

3005f4c5-e17b-531b-b9bf-c9d69411c71f.content: In a free-form proposal, separate the evaluation plan into its own subsection heading.

4913f63e-ceb9-587a-ade9-494fc8f28849.content: Place pilot observation or initial prototype results near sentences supporting feasibility claims.

8ecaec22-7c25-5a39-a85b-56db9c3b607e.content: HCI reviewers identify the user and interaction problem in the first two sentences of the opening paragraph to form their initial framing of the proposal.

a4536b84-40f2-57db-84e4-024c97c9fecb.content: HCI reviewers judge the rationale for researching this user problem immediately from the first two sentences of the opening paragraph.

2312cb6e-4f50-56f5-b725-ba5e45697a73.content: Link how controlled formative evaluations at each design phase alter subsequent design decisions in the proposal.

1d90043b-f010-5a14-9493-77f636c13975.content: Connect the interaction phenomena observed from the user problem, the design choices to be compared, and the conceptual design knowledge derived into a single thread.

b77fe6ec-676b-5bb9-9119-45aefea2aa27.content: The agent can review the overall research logic only if it is evident how each research phase constrains the design decisions of the next phase.
